TOOL: python3 - <<'PY'
import openpyxl, os
from openpyxl import load_workbook

input_path='/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/15380__1_15380_init/1_15380_init.xlsx'
out_path='/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/15380__1_15380_init/1_15380_output.xlsx'

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet3']

# Build lookup from named ranges codes2 -> month using the sheet data.
lookup = {}
for row in range(3, 15):
    code = ws[f'D{row}'].value
    month = ws[f'E{row}'].value
    if code is not None:
        lookup[str(code)] = month

# Populate B3:B14 based on the month code embedded in A-column strings.
for row in range(3, 15):
    text = ws[f'A{row}'].value
    if isinstance(text, str) and '_' in text:
        parts = text.split('_')
        code = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        ws[f'B{row}'] = lookup.get(code, None)

wb.save(out_path)
priinput_path='/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/15380__1_15380_init/1_15380_init.xlsx'
out_path='/workspace/skill-lab/results/spreadsheetbench/gpt-5.4-mini/bootstrapped/seed_replicates/seed1/trace2skill/seed_rollout/.work/15380__1_15380_init/1_15380_output.xlsx'

wb = load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb['Sheet3']

# Build lookup from named ranges codes2 -> month using the sheet data.
lookup = {}
for row in range(3, 15):
    code = ws[f'D{row}'].value
    month = ws[f'E{row}'].value
    if code is not None:
        lookup[str(code)] = month

# Populate B3:B14 based on the month code embedded in A-column strings.
for row in range(3, 15):
    text = ws[f'A{row}'].value
    if isinstance(text, str) and '_' in text:
        parts = text.split('_')
        code = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ''
        ws[f'B{row}'] = lookup.get(code, None)

wb.save(out_path)
print('saved', out_path, os.path.getsize(out_path))
